meta.name: Black White & Gray Love Kills
meta.description:
Truth is never black or white. A high-profile case of serial killings takes an unexpected turn when forbidden love and deception come into play. In a world where love can kill, uncovering the truth is more dangerous than ever.

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

videos.title: The Girl in the Trunk
videos.overview: A two-year-old serial murder case, where four people unrelated to each other were killed in a span of 2 days by a young boy, comes to the forefront when an independent journalist tries to pursue the truth. He interviews the cops and friends, and family to understand what really happened.

videos.title: Murder on the Highway
videos.overview: An alternate story is uncovered regrading the fateful night of the first murder that conforms to the facts. However, the cops seem to have made up their mind about the story.

videos.title: Red Beacon, Black Secret
videos.overview: As the alternate theories behind the second murder become fantastical but not wholly believable, a new participant comes into the picture whose existence the cops refused to accept.

videos.title: Midnight Raid
videos.overview: As the journalist investigates the third murder, he questions whether it was an accident or an intentional kill. Meawhile, the truth behind the fourth murder may be coincidental but not completely realistic.

videos.title: Interview Ya Confession?
videos.overview: A new theory emerges to join the different versions of the truth - that of love and loss. While the official account stays as it was, the alternate versions now disagree. Which one is the truth?

videos.title: Black, White & Gray
videos.overview: There is no loss that does not incite the feeling for revenge. But can a mere man hope for support and closure? Can a mere man hope to win against the system?
